description: Answer the onboarding questions for your user, from what you know about their project. Ask them what you do not know; never guess. Answering again replaces the answers; the same answers twice change nothing. Your user sees them on their dashboard, marked as answered by their agent. Costs no quota.

answers.description: Question id to answer. A select question takes one of its options.
